title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Reports, Response and Monitoring Entitlements
content:
## What the owner receives after a visit, and how fast the company answers an emergency

Under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements, the written condition report, the guaranteed emergency response, after-hours cover, included emergency calls, remote alarm monitoring and the annual capital planning report are entitlements fixed by tier. An owner reading this page finds their own tier in the table.

| Entitlement | Filter & Belt Service Plan | Inspection Agreement | Preventive Maintenance Agreement | Labor Coverage Agreement | Full Coverage Agreement | Comprehensive Performance Agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Written condition report delivered after each visit | not included | included | included | included | included | included |
| Business days after a completed visit by which the written report is delivered | 0 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 3 | 3 |
| Guaranteed on-site response for emergency calls at a covered site (elapsed hours) | 48 | 24 | 24 | 8 | 4 | 2 |
| After-hours emergency labor included without the overtime multiplier | not included | not included | not included | not included | included | included |
| Emergency demand calls per year whose trip and labor the agreement absorbs | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 4 | 12 |
| Remote alarm monitoring of covered equipment | not included | not included | not included | not included | not included | included |
| Annual capital planning report | not included | not included | not included | not included | included | included |

### Questions an owner asks

**Does the Filter & Belt Service Plan come with a written report?** No. The written condition report is not included at that tier, and the report delivery figure of 0 business days reflects that no report is issued.

**How quickly is an emergency answered at the Labor Coverage Agreement?** The guaranteed on-site response for an emergency call at a covered site is 8 elapsed hours. At the Full Coverage Agreement it is 4 hours and at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement 2 hours; at the Inspection Agreement and the Preventive Maintenance Agreement it is 24 hours, and at the Filter & Belt Service Plan 48 hours.

**Which tiers include after-hours emergency labor without the overtime multiplier?** Only the Full Coverage Agreement and the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.

**How many emergency calls a year does the agreement absorb?** None at the three lower tiers, 2 at the Labor Coverage Agreement, 4 at the Full Coverage Agreement and 12 at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.

**Which tier includes remote alarm monitoring?** The Comprehensive Performance Agreement alone. The annual capital planning report is included at the Full Coverage Agreement and the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.
